description:
Specification: adapt existing Mattermost/email journeys and selection tests to assert final selection and delivery rather than removed Jido-state/mailbox internals. Retain exact bytes, MIME/name, recipient/thread IDs, source preservation, no early/duplicate delivery, revocation before delivery, failure/cancellation, steering and request isolation. Preserve public ToolStep restrictions; assert the approved private trace contract.
Files: test/zaq/agent/attachment_selection_test.exs, tools/data_source/attach_documents_test.exs, stream_events tests, test/zaq/channels/attachment_agent_journey_test.exs and affected support fixtures; docs/services/agent.md, docs/e2e-testing.md and relevant moduledocs.
Tests before implementation: map every removed internal assertion to an existing observable invariant or an explicitly approved policy change; add missing public-projection and alias-lifetime regression cases before final cleanup.
Action reuse: existing real ingress/Engine/Factory/GetDocument/StreamEvents/Outgoing/Materialization/Channels paths; reuse approved external LLM/Mattermost/SMTP fixtures. No new operational logic or test-only production seams.
Mocking: external protocol collaborators only; per-test resources, no async global Application env mutation.
E2E: preserve accepted existing scenarios; no new feature UX or substantially rewritten E2E authorized by this tracking request. If scope expands, obtain the handbook's UX/UI approval before authoring that expansion.
Validation: isolated affected suites plus mix q per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Distinguish observed SMTP hostname-resolution environment failures from refactor regressions; do not mask them with longer timeouts.
Acceptance: behavior matrix passes, documentation matches implementation, reviewer ownership/privacy concern is resolved and review approval is recorded before coverage.

Required policies: docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/agent.md, docs/testing-approach.md; documentation edits additionally follow docs/documentation.md. No implementation authorized yet.
